You want us to kill your son?[XENO:n ]
That is no small request.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]There are hardly any of us Machina left on Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Back when the Giant God and the Machine God were fighting,[XENO:n ]
the Giant God almost completely wiped us out.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I suppose the Giant God just didn't want us around.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
Maynus-sama fought the Giant God for us.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]In the end, the two titans wounded each other[XENO:n ]
and entered a deep slumber.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Who was Maynus-sama?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The creator of Machine God. You could[XENO:n ]
say that she is the Machine God itself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You talk like you saw all this.[XENO:n ]
Ain't this all just an ancient myth?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I know I look young, but I'm actually quite old.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I saw the whole thing with my own eyes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]You can't be serious?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The people of Machine God must have a longer lifespan.[XENO:n ]
Just like we High Entia live far longer than Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT22 ]I get that, but he can't have lived that long.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But why do you want your son dead?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

From what you've told us, I would've thought you'd want us[XENO:n ]
to destroy the Giant God rather than kill your own son.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Egil was a brilliant young man.[XENO:n ]
Clever, strong and kind to the less able.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But he never forgave the Giant God for what it did,[XENO:n ]
and he swore to take revenge.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]So he wants to do to us what the[XENO:n ]
Giant God did to the Machina?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Correct. Egil is trying to eradicate all[XENO:n ]
innocent life on Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]He has to be stopped.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Didn't you ever try to stop him?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]We tried, once. A lot of people were killed.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

He's blinded by revenge. Even Maynus-sama[XENO:n ]
herself couldn't convince him to stop.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Where is Egil now?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Most likely the Machine God capital.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
He's trying to restore its former glory all by himself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I feel sorry for him.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]What're you talkin' about?![XENO:n ]
Did you forget what he did to us?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]I haven't forgotten, or forgiven![XENO:n ]
But Egil's clearly suffered a lot in his life.[XENO:n ]
You don't feel any sympathy at all?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]All I know is, this stinks.[XENO:n ]
Who cares what he's been through?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Rein![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]I understand about Egil. But why us?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]You should be aware that Shulk's sword, the Monado,[XENO:n ]
has the power to destroy Machine God weaponry.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It's said that it was once the sword of the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
Doesn't the very sight of it make you quiver?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Zanza...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ]Just talking to myself.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If you're gonna kill Egil, you'll[XENO:n ]
need all of that sword's power.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
That's how strong Egil is.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

But enough talk, you must be tired.[XENO:n ]
Take your time and think it over.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Until the young lady's treatment has finished[XENO:n ]
feel free to spend time in our village.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
